parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh-CN (default): Chinese
*   en-US: English
*   ja: Japanese

parameters.name: Address
parameters.description: Specifies whether to monitor Ingress classes.

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: Specifies whether to update the Ingress status.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The namespace whose resources you want to monitor.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The service source.

*   K8s: ACK cluster
*   NACOS: MSE Nacos instance

parameters.name: ToAuthorizeSecurityGroups
parameters.description: The list of security groups to be authorized. You can specify security groups to allow backend services to access data sources that you create.

sub_parameters.name: Description
sub_parameters.description: The description of the authorization record.

sub_parameters.name: PortRange
sub_parameters.description: The authorized port range of the security group. You can select multiple port ranges. Separate each port range with a comma (,).

sub_parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the security group.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the service source.

*   K8s: Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster
*   NACOS: Nacos instance
